answer_1.quote: This paper proposes a novel multi-source heterogeneous knowledge-enhanced dialogue generation model, MSKE-Dialog.

answer_2.quote: We use the embedding-based Embed-A/G/X (Average/Greedy/Extreme), ROUGE-L, and BLEU to evaluate the relevance to the ground-truth responses. Following, we use DIST-Uni/Bi (the ratio of distinct 1/2-grams among all generated tokens), and the 4-gram entropy Ent4 to evaluate the diversity.

answer_4.quote: We employ 3 well-educated native speakers to annotate the sampled 200 test cases.
answer_4.guideline: There are two criteria: (1) Appropriateness evaluates the fluency, and the relevance to the context; (2) Informativeness evaluates how much new knowledge is provided.
